purchase.notes: Bought at card show; allocated shipping to this copy.

formula.expression: all_in_total = purchase_price + shipping + tax + fees + supplies

requiredFields.note: Only these three are REQUIRED to save Purchased. Others default to 0.

optionalFieldsProvided.note: User entered tax and supplies; shipping and fees defaulted to 0 (in-person cash buy).

listingDraftContext.copyRule: NEVER label as 'guaranteed profit'; show as 'potential margin (estimate only)'

fieldDefinitions.purchasePrice: What the user paid for the card / lot line
fieldDefinitions.shipping: Inbound shipping allocated to this copy
fieldDefinitions.tax: Sales tax / VAT allocated to this copy
fieldDefinitions.fees: Buy-side platform or payment fees (NOT eBay/TCGplayer seller fees)
fieldDefinitions.supplies: Sleeves, toploaders, penny sleeves allocated to this copy
fieldDefinitions.allInTotal: Sum of the five money fields; persisted at save time

_meta.description: MOCK EXAMPLE — Complete all-in cost with all five breakdown lines: purchase_price, shipping, tax, fees, supplies. Pikachu purchased copy; user entered tax and supplies. All-in total is $4.04. Listing draft asking $9.00 shows potential spread $4.96 (never 'guaranteed profit'). Amounts shown as decimal strings for readability; persist minor units later.
